<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Probe: press UP (seemed neutral for RIGHT). Check if grid W-cells reappear or handle moves.
import copy
before=current_frame
r=action(['UP'])
res=last_action_result
print("board_changed:",res.get('board_changed'),"done:",res.get('done'))
f=current_frame
seg=f.segmentation['nodes']
w=n=0
for nd in seg:
    bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd)
    if 48<=r0<=62 and 23<=c0<=37:
        if nd['color']=='W': w+=nd['pixels']
        if nd['color']=='N': n+=nd['pixels']
# dumbbell right-edge handle
handle=[]
for nd in seg:
    if nd['color'] in ('b','S'):
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 17<=r0<=22 and c0>=38: handle.append((nd['color'],r0,min(p[1] for p in bnd),c1,nd['pixels']))
print("after UP: gridW",w,"gridN",n,"handle",handle,"step",f.step)
# diff before/after
d=frame_sequence.diff(before=0,after=-1,max_changes=8)
print("diff:",d)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
